svg.title: Xenon electron spectrum
svg.desc: Ten measured xenon lines with a resolved 5p doublet. The brightest lines are the gold 4d doublet.
svg.metadata: Fitted peak positions, widths, heights and beta coefficients are from the supplied experimental table. Baseline slice intensity is estimated by height / sqrt(r squared). Peak brightness is balanced by eye for each line. Angular profiles and radial FWHMs follow the experimental fit. The core uses a Gaussian in r squared. Outer arc gaps use a 0.0525 display floor with a smooth transition up to 0.090 before brightness balancing. Center glow, hues and halo widths are illustration choices.
